blocks.text: Cebu Parklane International Hotel marked the Christmas season on November 20, 2026, with Kalinaw sa Pasko sa Banay: A Belen Lighting Ceremony, a celebration rooted in the Cebuano spirit of resilience after a year of challenges brought by an earthquake and Typhoon Tino. Centered on the Nativity, the Belen lighting reflects this year’s message that Christmas is not simply about giving, but finding peace at home, reconnecting with family, and drawing strength from the people who remain by our side.
